pd_torque: convert inputs with np.asarray, default qd_des to np.zeros_like(qd), return Kp * (q_des - q) + Kd * (qd_des - qd). pd_gains: kp = J wn**2, kd = 2 zeta wn J. overshoot_from_zeta: 0.0 if zeta >= 1 else exp(-zeta pi / sqrt(1 - zeta**2)). settling_time_estimate: -log(0.02) / (zeta wn).

step_metrics: r = (y - y_start) / (y_target - y_start). overshoot = max(r.max() - 1, 0). rise: first t where r >= 0.9 minus first t where r >= 0.1 (np.flatnonzero(cond)[0]). settling: idx = np.flatnonzero(abs(r - 1) > band); if empty -> t[0]; if the last outside sample is the final one -> t[-1]; else t[idx[-1] + 1]. ss_error = y_target - y[-1]. gravity_droop: q = q_des; repeat iters times: q = q_des - g_fn(q) / Kp.

run_mujoco_control: data = mujoco.MjData(model); n = model.nu; data.qpos[:n] = q0; optional data.qvel[:n] = qd0; mujoco.mj_forward(model, data); dt = model.opt.timestep; for k in range(round(duration / dt)): tau = controller(k * dt, data.qpos[:n].copy(), data.qvel[:n].copy()); data.ctrl[:n] = tau; if before_step: before_step(model, data, k * dt); mujoco.mj_step(model, data); append copies of qpos[:n], qvel[:n] and tau. Return np.arange(N + 1) * dt and the stacked arrays.
